employment.title: Research Scientist
employment.summary: Designed and ran experiments to evaluate predictive algorithms; improved model accuracy by 12%. Built and maintained SQL + Python data processing pipelines to automate dataset creation and validation. Developed statistical models and performed hypothesis testing (power analysis, confidence intervals, regression). Produced technical reports and streamlined documentation for reproducibility.

employment.title: Research Analyst to Research Scientist, Data Science Research
employment.summary: Conducted literature reviews and prototyped ML baselines (scikit-learn, XGBoost). Implemented monitoring for data drift/model degradation and created dashboards. Collaborated with engineers to transition prototypes into production workflows (unit testing, model versioning). Cleaned/curated datasets using outlier detection and normalization.
